landmarks.name: Puerta de Alcalá
landmarks.description: Monumental gate from 1778, the old entrance to Madrid on the road from Alcalá.
landmarks.description_es: Puerta monumental de 1778, la antigua entrada a Madrid por el camino de Alcalá.

landmarks.name: Acueducto de Segovia
landmarks.description: 1st-century Roman aqueduct with more than 160 granite arches built without mortar.
landmarks.description_es: Acueducto romano del siglo I con más de 160 arcos de granito levantados sin argamasa.

landmarks.name: Sagrada Familia
landmarks.description: Gaudí's basilica, under construction since 1882, with 18 planned towers.
landmarks.description_es: La basílica de Gaudí, en obras desde 1882, con 18 torres previstas.

landmarks.name: La Giralda
landmarks.description: Bell tower of Seville Cathedral, once a 12th-century Almohad minaret.
landmarks.description_es: Campanario de la catedral de Sevilla, antes alminar almohade del siglo XII.

landmarks.name: La Alhambra
landmarks.description: Nasrid palace city from the 13th and 14th centuries on the Sabika hill.
landmarks.description_es: Ciudad palatina nazarí de los siglos XIII y XIV sobre la colina de la Sabika.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Santiago
landmarks.description: End of the Way of St. James, with its Baroque Obradoiro façade.
landmarks.description_es: Final del Camino de Santiago, con su fachada barroca del Obradoiro.

landmarks.name: Museo Guggenheim
landmarks.description: Frank Gehry's 1997 museum, clad in titanium beside the estuary.
landmarks.description_es: El museo de Frank Gehry de 1997, revestido de titanio junto a la ría.

landmarks.name: Ciudad de las Artes y las Ciencias
landmarks.description: Santiago Calatrava's complex in the old bed of the Turia river.
landmarks.description_es: El conjunto de Santiago Calatrava en el antiguo cauce del río Turia.

landmarks.name: Torre de Hércules
landmarks.description: 1st-century Roman lighthouse, the oldest in the world still in use.
landmarks.description_es: Faro romano del siglo I, el más antiguo del mundo aún en funcionamiento.

landmarks.name: Mezquita-Catedral
landmarks.description: 8th-century Umayyad mosque with its forest of red and white arches.
landmarks.description_es: Mezquita omeya del siglo VIII con su bosque de arcos rojos y blancos.

landmarks.name: Peñafiel Castle
landmarks.description: Long, narrow 'ship-shaped' castle on a hill crest, with a 34 m keep between two courtyards.
landmarks.description_es: Castillo largo y estrecho «en forma de barco» sobre la cresta de un cerro, con una torre del homenaje de 34 m entre dos patios.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Burgos
landmarks.description: Gothic cathedral begun in 1221, famous for its openwork spires and crossing lantern.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica empezada en 1221, famosa por sus agujas caladas y su cimborrio.

landmarks.name: Teatro Romano
landmarks.description: Roman theatre from 16-15 BC with a two-storey columned stage front, still used for plays.
landmarks.description_es: Teatro romano del 16-15 a. C. con un frente escénico de columnas en dos pisos, donde aún se representan obras.

landmarks.name: Basílica del Pilar
landmarks.description: Baroque basilica beside the Ebro, with four tall towers and domes of glazed tiles.
landmarks.description_es: Basílica barroca junto al Ebro, con cuatro torres altas y cúpulas de tejas vidriadas.

landmarks.name: Casas Colgadas
landmarks.description: 15th-century Hanging Houses with wooden balconies over the cliff of the Huécar gorge.
landmarks.description_es: Casas Colgadas del siglo XV con balcones de madera sobre el cortado de la hoz del Huécar.

landmarks.name: Plaza Mayor
landmarks.description: 18th-century Baroque square of golden sandstone, closed on all four sides by arcades.
landmarks.description_es: Plaza barroca del siglo XVIII de arenisca dorada, cerrada por soportales en sus cuatro lados.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Murcia
landmarks.description: Gothic cathedral with a Baroque altarpiece façade by Jaime Bort and one of the tallest bell towers in Spain.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica con una fachada barroca en forma de retablo de Jaime Bort y uno de los campanarios más altos de España.

landmarks.name: Alcazaba
landmarks.description: 10th-century Moorish fortress whose walls and towers climb a rocky ridge above Almería in three enclosures, crowned by a Christian castle.
landmarks.description_es: Fortaleza andalusí del siglo X cuyas murallas y torres trepan por una cresta rocosa sobre Almería en tres recintos, coronada por un castillo cristiano.

landmarks.name: Alcázar
landmarks.description: Square Renaissance fortress crowning the hill of Toledo, with four corner towers topped by slate spires around an arcaded courtyard.
landmarks.description_es: Fortaleza renacentista cuadrada que corona el cerro de Toledo, con cuatro torres en las esquinas rematadas por chapiteles de pizarra alrededor de un patio porticado.

landmarks.name: Murallas de Ávila
landmarks.description: Complete 12th-century granite walls with 87 round towers; here the Puerta del Alcázar between its two great towers.
landmarks.description_es: Murallas de granito completas del siglo XII con 87 torres redondas; aquí, la Puerta del Alcázar entre sus dos grandes torreones.

landmarks.name: Catedral de León
landmarks.description: 13th-century Gothic cathedral, 'Pulchra Leonina', with almost 1,800 square metres of stained glass.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica del siglo XIII, la 'Pulchra Leonina', con casi 1.800 metros cuadrados de vidrieras.

landmarks.name: Cristo del Otero
landmarks.description: Art Deco statue of Christ by Victorio Macho (1931), over 20 m tall, blessing Palencia from its hill.
landmarks.description_es: Estatua art déco de Cristo de Victorio Macho (1931), de más de 20 m, que bendice Palencia desde su cerro.

landmarks.name: Arcos de San Juan de Duero
landmarks.description: Cloister of a 12th-century monastery of the Knights Hospitaller by the Duero, with its unusual interlaced arches.
landmarks.description_es: Claustro de un monasterio de los caballeros hospitalarios del siglo XII junto al Duero, con sus curiosos arcos entrecruzados.

landmarks.name: Iglesia de San Pablo
landmarks.description: Dominican church whose late-Gothic façade is carved like a stone altarpiece.
landmarks.description_es: Iglesia dominica cuya fachada gótica tardía está tallada como un retablo de piedra.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Zamora
landmarks.description: 12th-century Romanesque cathedral crowned by its famous dome of stone scales and four corner turrets.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral románica del siglo XII coronada por su famoso cimborrio de escamas de piedra y cuatro torrecillas.

landmarks.name: Palacio del Infantado
landmarks.description: 15th-century palace of the Mendoza family, its façade studded with diamond-point stones under an arcaded gallery.
landmarks.description_es: Palacio de los Mendoza del siglo XV, con la fachada cubierta de puntas de diamante bajo una galería porticada.

landmarks.name: Puerta de Toledo
landmarks.description: Gothic-Mudéjar gate from 1328, the last of the old city wall, between two crenellated towers.
landmarks.description_es: Puerta gótico-mudéjar de 1328, la última de la antigua muralla, entre dos torres almenadas.

landmarks.name: Puerta de Hierros
landmarks.description: White entrance gate of the round fairground where the September fair has been held since the 18th century.
landmarks.description_es: Puerta blanca de entrada al recinto ferial redondo donde se celebra la feria de septiembre desde el siglo XVIII.

landmarks.name: Torre de Bujaco
landmarks.description: Almohad tower on the Plaza Mayor, beside the Arco de la Estrella that leads into the walled old town.
landmarks.description_es: Torre almohade en la Plaza Mayor, junto al Arco de la Estrella que da paso a la ciudad amurallada.

landmarks.name: Puerta de Palmas
landmarks.description: 16th-century city gate between two round crenellated towers, at the end of the old bridge over the Guadiana.
landmarks.description_es: Puerta de la ciudad del siglo XVI entre dos torres redondas almenadas, al final del puente viejo sobre el Guadiana.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Oviedo
landmarks.description: Gothic cathedral of San Salvador with a three-arched porch and a single tower crowned by an openwork spire.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica de San Salvador con un pórtico de tres arcos y una única torre rematada por una aguja calada.

landmarks.name: Palacio de la Magdalena
landmarks.description: Early 20th-century summer palace of the royal family, with English-style slate roofs, on a peninsula by the bay.
landmarks.description_es: Palacio de verano de la familia real de principios del siglo XX, con tejados de pizarra de estilo inglés, en una península junto a la bahía.

landmarks.name: Muralla de Lugo
landmarks.description: 3rd-century Roman walls, over 2 km long with 85 towers, the only Roman walls still complete around a city.
landmarks.description_es: Muralla romana del siglo III, de más de 2 km y 85 torres, la única muralla romana que aún rodea entera una ciudad.

landmarks.name: Santuario da Peregrina
landmarks.description: 18th-century Baroque church with a round plan shaped like a scallop shell, on the Portuguese Way to Santiago.
landmarks.description_es: Iglesia barroca del siglo XVIII con planta redonda en forma de concha de vieira, en el Camino Portugués a Santiago.

landmarks.name: Catedral del Buen Pastor
landmarks.description: Neo-Gothic cathedral from 1897 whose 75 m spire is the tallest building in the city.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral neogótica de 1897 cuya aguja de 75 m es el edificio más alto de la ciudad.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Santa María
landmarks.description: Gothic cathedral on the top of the medieval town, with a painted portico and its bell tower beside it.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica en lo alto de la villa medieval, con un pórtico pintado y su campanario al lado.

landmarks.name: Ayuntamiento de Pamplona
landmarks.description: Baroque town hall whose balcony opens the San Fermín festival every 6 July with the 'chupinazo' rocket.
landmarks.description_es: Ayuntamiento barroco desde cuyo balcón arrancan los Sanfermines cada 6 de julio con el chupinazo.

landmarks.name: Concatedral de La Redonda
landmarks.description: Church on the Way of St. James, famous for its two 18th-century Baroque towers known as 'the twins'.
landmarks.description_es: Iglesia del Camino de Santiago, famosa por sus dos torres barrocas del siglo XVIII conocidas como 'las gemelas'.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Girona
landmarks.description: Cathedral with the widest Gothic nave in the world, at the top of a grand Baroque staircase.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral con la nave gótica más ancha del mundo, en lo alto de una gran escalinata barroca.

landmarks.name: La Seu Vella
landmarks.description: 13th-century cathedral on the hill above the Segre, with a 60 m octagonal bell tower that can be seen from the whole plain.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral del siglo XIII en el cerro sobre el Segre, con un campanario octogonal de 60 m que se ve desde toda la llanura.

landmarks.name: Amfiteatre de Tarraco
landmarks.description: 2nd-century Roman amphitheatre by the sea, with the ruins of a Romanesque church in its arena.
landmarks.description_es: Anfiteatro romano del siglo II junto al mar, con las ruinas de una iglesia románica en su arena.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Huesca
landmarks.description: Gothic cathedral whose deep portal is sheltered by a carved wooden Mudéjar eave.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica cuya profunda portada está protegida por un alero mudéjar de madera tallada.

landmarks.name: Torre de El Salvador
landmarks.description: 14th-century Mudéjar brick tower over a street arch, inlaid with green and white glazed tiles (UNESCO World Heritage).
landmarks.description_es: Torre mudéjar de ladrillo del siglo XIV sobre un arco de la calle, decorada con azulejos verdes y blancos (Patrimonio de la Humanidad).

landmarks.name: El Fadrí
landmarks.description: Octagonal Gothic bell tower, 58 m tall, standing on its own beside the co-cathedral ('fadrí' means bachelor).
landmarks.description_es: Campanario gótico octogonal de 58 m, exento junto a la concatedral ('fadrí' significa soltero).

landmarks.name: Castillo de Santa Bárbara
landmarks.description: Castle on the top of Mount Benacantil, 166 m above the port of Alicante.
landmarks.description_es: Castillo en la cima del monte Benacantil, a 166 m sobre el puerto de Alicante.

landmarks.name: La Seu
landmarks.description: Gothic cathedral of Mallorca facing the sea, with tall buttresses and one of the largest rose windows in the world.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral gótica de Mallorca frente al mar, con altos contrafuertes y uno de los mayores rosetones del mundo.

landmarks.name: Monumento a la Fe Descubridora
landmarks.description: 37 m statue of a friar holding a tau cross (1929), a gift from the United States for the voyage of Columbus.
landmarks.description_es: Estatua de 37 m de un fraile con una cruz en forma de tau (1929), regalo de Estados Unidos por el viaje de Colón.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Jaén
landmarks.description: Renaissance cathedral by Andrés de Vandelvira, model for many cathedrals in Latin America.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral renacentista de Andrés de Vandelvira, modelo de muchas catedrales de Hispanoamérica.

landmarks.name: Catedral de Málaga
landmarks.description: Renaissance cathedral nicknamed 'La Manquita' (the one-armed lady) because its south tower was never finished.
landmarks.description_es: Catedral renacentista apodada 'La Manquita' porque su torre sur nunca se terminó.
